Even though it's an indoor circuit, the natural light from the skylights creates a fantastic atmosphere here at Speedland, bouncing off the karts as they fly past.

The 2015 Brazilian Karting Championship saw an incredible title decider right here on the Interior circuit, decided by just a tenth of a second.
Several karting legends have graced this track. Speedland holds a special place in the hearts of Brazilian motorsport fans.
They say this track has seen more karting action than any other in South America, and you can feel the history as you walk through the paddock.
Many local teams have risen from humble beginnings to become international karting powerhouses, all thanks to the opportunities provided by Speedland.
Speedland has played host to several international karting events, attracting top drivers from around the globe to compete on this challenging layout.

cornerCallouts: Drivers need to be precise through the opening sequence. It's all about momentum heading into Turn 1.
The hairpin at Turn 3 is a real overtaking opportunity, but also a potential bottleneck.
Turn 4 is a tricky, off-camber corner that requires a delicate touch on the throttle.
The exit of Turn 5 is crucial for setting up a run down the short back straight.
Turn 2 is a crucial braking zone that often determines who gains position early on.
The final corner, Turn 6, is all about carrying speed onto the start/finish straight.
The run from turn 5 to turn 6 is a very short back straight, but can still yield some very important momentum.
The transition from Turn 1 to Turn 2 requires a deft touch, as it is easy to unsettle the kart.
strategyPoints: Tire wear is a real factor here at Speedland. Managing the rubber over the course of the race will be key to a strong finish on this short 0.6km layout.
With such a short lap, traffic management will be crucial. Finding a clear lap for a qualifying run could be the difference between pole position and starting further back.
Fuel load is less of a concern on the Interior layout, but carrying extra weight will still impact lap times. It's a delicate balance.
The pit window will be relatively short, so teams need to be prepared for quick and efficient stops.
Given the tight and twisty nature of the circuit, a good qualifying position is vital. Overtaking is difficult on this layout.
The kart setup needs to be optimized for maximum grip and acceleration out of the corners. Top speed is less important here.
Maintaining a consistent rhythm is essential. One small mistake can cost valuable time on this compact circuit.
With the frequent acceleration and braking, energy management is crucial. Drivers need to be smooth and efficient to conserve their kart's battery.
weatherCommentary: The indoor setting means the weather outside is irrelevant. Consistent track conditions are guaranteed here at Speedland.
Even on a rainy day in Brazil, the racing here at Speedland is unaffected. It's always a good time to go karting!
The humidity can be a factor inside the building, affecting tire grip and driver comfort.
The temperature inside Speedland is carefully controlled, providing optimal conditions for racing.
No need to worry about sun glare or rain here! Inside, the racing continues no matter what mother nature throws at us.
